subject.title: Telegram: support fail-closed unknown-group handling with optional auto-leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group action that can warn and leave non-allowlisted groups before assistant execution?
rationale: The request adds new Telegram config and an operator-controlled security side effect, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Revise the linked Telegram PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50682 as the implementation starting point, but require schema/docs alignment, precise unknown-group classification, conflict resolution, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep deny-only behavior
options.body: Decline warn/leave config for now and keep the current fail-closed drop/log behavior as the supported Telegram posture.

options.title: Fold into broader group security work
options.body: Defer this narrow Telegram auto-leave request into the broader group pairing/security direction tracked by related issues.

recommendation.title: Revise the linked Telegram PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50682 as the implementation starting point, but require schema/docs alignment, precise unknown-group classification, conflict resolution, and real Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current code and docs history for Telegram group authorization and config surfaces most directly points to steipete.
